name: Finite-difference weights by moment matching
definition: Provisional: for distinct offsets s_j and derivative order m<n, solve Σ_(j=0)^(n−1) w_j s_j^k=m! δ_(km) for k=0,…,n−1; approximate f^(m)(x) by Σ_j w_j f(x+s_j).
variables: n nodes; m derivative order; s_j offsets; w_j weights; δ Kronecker delta
assumptions: Distinct nodes and adequate smoothness; nonsingular moment system
limitations: Direct Vandermonde systems can be ill-conditioned; not Fornberg recursion
failure_conditions: Duplicate nodes, nonfinite samples or unresolved linear solve
